EEI Corp Announces Major Investment to Expand Construction Operations

EEI Corp, a leading player in the Philippines’ engineering and construction sector, announced on Friday a significant investment aimed at expanding its domestic operations and enhancing its project delivery capacity. The move comes amid rising demand for infrastructure development, both from the public and private sectors.

The company disclosed plans to allocate approximately PHP 2.3 billion over the next two years to upgrade equipment, expand its workforce, and strengthen its project management capabilities. A substantial portion of the investment will be directed towards the acquisition of advanced construction machinery and the development of a state-of-the-art training center for engineers and skilled workers in Laguna.

“Our commitment is to support the country's growth momentum by ensuring that we are equipped to deliver world-class engineering solutions,” said Roberto Valenzuela, EEI Corp’s president and CEO. “This expansion will not only boost our operational efficiency but also create hundreds of new jobs in the process.”

Industry analysts welcomed the announcement, noting the favorable outlook for the Philippine construction sector. “Infrastructure spending remains a priority in the government’s economic agenda, and EEI Corp is well-positioned to capture a larger share of upcoming projects,” said Maria Solis, an analyst at Pacifica Research. She added that the company’s focus on technology and talent development could set a new benchmark for the industry.

The Construction Industry Association of the Philippines (CIAP) also lauded the initiative. In a statement, CIAP Chairman Ernesto Lim remarked, “Investments like this will help close the skills gap in our sector and raise standards across the board.”

EEI Corp’s board of directors has approved the investment package, with the first phase of expansion scheduled to commence in the third quarter of 2024. The company is currently evaluating potential partnerships with local suppliers such as Atlas Equipment and Pioneer Materials to support its procurement needs.

Shares of EEI Corp closed 1.2% higher on Friday following the announcement.
